description: This source file defines a custom schema filter for OpenAPI/Swagger integration, specifically targeting the removal of certain properties from schema definitions.

classes.name: CustomSchemaFilters
classes.description: A class implementing ISchemaFilter to customize how schemas are generated in Swagger, specifically by removing the 'CorrelationId' property from schemas.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the schema filter to modify the schema by removing specific properties, notably 'CorrelationId'.
